title.narrative: Yntymaktuu Zhashoo (Living in Peace): Rapid, multi-level reduction of tensions and prevention of election-related violence in 25 districts in Kyrgyzstan

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is: Opportunities for election-related violence in the post-election situation in 25 districts in Kyrgyzstan have been minimised through locally led, multi-level interventions, intense political dialogue and analysis, and alternative messaging to zero-sum political culture.
